entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The pulse reading is completely wrong. It's basically garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can try some troubleshooting with you or transfer you to our technical support team to get that sorted out.
Look, I don't have time for all that. It doesn't work. You just want money for a broken product. I want a refund.
I understand your frustration and that you'd prefer a straightforward solution. Let me pull up your account and review the order. Can I get the email address you used for the purchase?
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered to you on December 15th.
I'm just checking our return policy here... and yes, it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window.

Absolutely. Since you're within the timeframe, I can process that return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Oh. Okay, that's great. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
